lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Testing. Testing.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Wow, text messages are great! So easy.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Letters, numbers, special characters.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Test completed.
What are you doing?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I'm testing my device.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: All done.
Okay...
But why?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Hm...

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I was told to contact you,

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: and was given a cellphone.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Now that the test is complete, I can properly introduce myself.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I'm D.
Is that your real name?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: No, it's a code name.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I'm from the Perilous Siege squad.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Per orders from the Judges and the Central Government,

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I am to serve under your command, effective immediately.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Let me know if you need anything.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: If I'm not on an assignment, I'll offer assistance.
What exactly are these "assignments" you're referring to?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Tracking down and eliminating whoever

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: breaks the law, commits acts of transgression,

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: or otherwise poses a threat to the Ark.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: My targets encompass a wide range of individuals,

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: and occasionally even include high-ranking officials in the Ark and the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Once they are targeted for termination, their fate is sealed.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: That is my mission.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Naturally,

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: you could also become a potential target.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Bear that in mind.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: You're a person of some renown in the Ark.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: You've got a lot of eyes on you.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: The more Nikkes you have under your command,

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: the more people will see you as a threat.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: You'll have no shortage of enemies.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Be acutely aware of your words and actions.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I wouldn't want to see your name appear

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: on one of my mission briefings.
I'll keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: That's all I have to say.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Is there anything else you want to know?
Even if I did, I don't think you'd answer.
Not at the moment.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: A wise choice.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: So long as you don't become a target,

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I won't lay a finger on you.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: That I can promise you.
How reassuring.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Okay,

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: catch you later.
